note: FROZEN Stage-A single-part tracking body. The STL's own local frame IS the temporary body frame B_left.
copied_from: ~/handumi-hw/hardware/STL/left_handumi/fisheye_camera_main_support.stl (vendored into the repo so the mesh cannot drift or be swapped)
side_agnostic: left and right copies of this part are byte-identical (md5 6e5f09ce...) - it is the only entry in RIGID_PART_STEMS without a <side>_ prefix
why_this_part: largest rigid part by surface area (240 cm2, >2x the next); inertia spread 0.626 with the two smaller principal moments separated by 0.307, so orientation is not rotationally ambiguous

DO_NOT_USE.reason: same geometry translated by (60.49, 20.0, 69.0) mm = 93.9 mm into the positive octant for slicing. Its origin lies OUTSIDE the part (127 mm from the centroid) and tracking_mesh.validate() rejects it. Using it as B would offset every later T_B_TCP by 93.9 mm.

body_to_tcp: NOT CALIBRATED. T_D_TCP = T_D_B @ T_B_TCP; T_B_TCP absorbs the arbitrary CAD origin and is a Stage-B task.
